title: A study assessing the efficacy and safety of NEMOlizumab in patients ≥12yo with Dystrophic Epidermolysis bullosa; NEMODE
official: A pilot multicentric open study assessing the efficacy and safety of NEMOlizumab in patients ≥12yo with Dystrophic Epidermolysis bullosa; NEMODE
summary: Main objective: To study the efficacy of Nemolizumab on pruritus in patients > 12yo with DEB after 4 weeks of treatment, in a multicentric, prospective, and open pilot study.

interventions.name: Nemluvio 30 mg powder and solvent for solution for injection in pre-filled pen

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 12
2. Affiliation with a social security scheme
3. Subject has recessive or dominant dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa, confirmed by skin immunomapping and/or molecular analysis.
4. Subject has at least a baseline pruritus score ≥4/10
5. Subject agrees not to use any topical therapies other than the investigator approved (VYJUVEK gel is accepted if ongoing at the time of the study, excepted o the left leg).
6. Efficient contraceptive method
7. Subject is non-pregnant, non-lactating and is not planning for pregnancy during the study period
8. Subject is in good general health and free of any known disease state or physical condition which, in the investigator’s opinion, might impair his evaluation or which exposes the subject to an unacceptable risk by study participation
9. Subject is willing and able to follow all study instructions and to attend all study visits
10. Subject is able to comprehend and willing to sign an Informed Consent and/or Assent Form
Exclusion criteria:
1. Subjects who are treated with DUPILUMAB or JAK inhibitor. A wash out of 2 months is mandatory to be included
2. Subjects with not stable controlled asthma
3. Medical History and Concurrent Diseases
4. Subject has another member of her/his immediate family (i.e., living in the same household) enrolled in this study
5. Subject has used any systemic product that, in the opinion of the investigator, might put the subject at undue risk by study participation or interferes with the study assessments within 30 days prior to Visit 1
6. Vulnerable persons as mentioned in articles L1121-5, L1121-6, L1121-7, L1121-8 and L1122-1-2 of the public health code
7. Subject has a history of sensitivity to any of the ingredients of Nemolizumab
